title: Defence Amendment (Sexual Assault Prevention, Intervention and Response Commission) Bill 2025
short_title: Defence Amendment (Sexual Assault Prevention, Intervention and Response Commission) Bill 2025

speeches.speaker: David Pocock
speeches.brief: Moved for introduction of a bill establishing a Sexual Assault Prevention, Intervention and Response Commission under the Defence Act 1903; leave was granted, the bill was presented, and it was read a first time.

speeches.speaker: David Pocock
speeches.brief: Moved the second reading of a bill establishing an independent commission addressing sexual assault in the Australian Defence organisation. The bill would provide for prevention, intervention, investigation, training, data collection, accountability, victim-survivor support and duties for Defence leaders; debate was adjourned with leave for further remarks.

speeches.speaker: David Pocock
speeches.brief: Moved that the Defence commission bill be referred to the Foreign Affairs, Defence and Trade Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 4 May 2026; the motion was agreed to.
